note: No passwords, cookies, CSRF tokens, session IDs, or API token secrets are recorded here. Auth followed official Gateway pages and this Gateway's own OpenAPI; no Designer login or renewal API was invented.

web_session.entry: GET /data/app/login redirected to this Gateway's official IdP.
web_session.idp: authentication.js posted to /idp/default/authn/next-challenge and /idp/default/authn/submit-challenge/basic, then GET /idp/default/oidc/auth leading to /data/federate/callback/internal.
web_session.session: A webui-sid-* cookie plus GET /data/app/session provided the csrfToken used with X-CSRF-Token on mutative REST calls.

api_token_and_mcp.mcp_auth: Catalyst MCP did not accept the Web UI session. It required header X-Ignition-API-Token with value format keyName:secret.
api_token_and_mcp.securityLevels: Must be the object tree from this Gateway's OpenAPI / security-properties (Authenticated → Roles → Administrator). A string path such as Authenticated/Roles/Administrator returned 422 and did not persist a token.

authenticated_openapi.comparison: The official Docker image on this Mac loaded the full official module set, so authenticated OpenAPI had 696 paths / 809 operations versus 455 on the slimmer Linux-extract environment used earlier.
